notes.note: The transition route maps an unknown action to 400 invalid_campaign_action only for names absent from Object.prototype: lib/dialer/campaigns.ts indexes CAMPAIGN_TRANSITIONS[action] directly, so {"action":"constructor"} or "toString" finds a truthy inherited value, skips the guard and throws a TypeError that the route reports as 500. Fix belongs in the service layer (own-key check or a Map); this layer's scope excludes lib/**.

sweepRoute's kind:"caller" branch (404 with an empty body for a non-owner) has no registered row in this layer: every route in this story is an admin route. The branch is unchanged but unexercised until the caller-queue story registers the first caller route, so a regression in it would surface there rather than here.
